came in greeting Varick with a note of pleasure. <break time="0.8s" /> And Haskett a shade less warmly. <break time="0.8s" /> As though nothing could be more natural. <break time="0.8s" /> Shall we have tea in here, dear. <break time="0.8s" /> She asked her husband. <break time="0.8s" /> And with perfect composure. <break time="0.8s" /> She began to pour the tea. <break time="0.8s" /> While the three men watched in silence. <break time="0.8s" /> She handed a cup to each of her guests. <break time="0.8s" /> And so smoothly did she manage the moment. <break time="0.8s" /> That the awkwardness in the room. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to melt away. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she glanced about for her husband. <break time="0.8s" /> And Waythorn. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing at last the comedy of his own position. <break time="0.8s" /> Took the third cup with a laugh.
